description: Stopped by Dorotea. You stay at her house for the night. Lose your turn.
Ran over by a horse! You get hurt and need to go back to heal. Move back 3 spaces.
You confess your sins. You get scared someone heard you. Lose 10 sanity.
You see a ghost! You think you're hallucinating. Lose 15 sanity.
You turn a blind eye to Miguel murdering someone. You live with the guilt. Lose 20 sanity.
You ignore cries for help. The cries haunt you in your dreams. Lose 15 sanity.
You inherit Pedro's debt and have to fight in the war. Move back 4 spaces.
You stop to watch Miguel's funeral. You are wasting time. Lose your turn.
